title: Geometric Consistency Based Label-Free Validation for Checkpoint Selection in Audio Active Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.35329v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Audio active learning (AL) trains a classifier at low annotation cost by labeling only an informative fraction of an unlabeled collection over successive rounds. Each round picks one of the checkpoints saved during training. Mainstream AL protocols do so with an assumed validation set, but in practice its labels also count toward the annotation cost, shrinking the advantage of an already small annotation budget. We propose geometric consistency, a label-free validation rule for checkpoint selection. Both classifiers, nearest-class-mean and k-nearest-neighbor, are built from the labeled set in a frozen pretrained embedding space. They then predict the unlabeled data to model its geometry. The rule scores each checkpoint by its agreement with these pseudo-labels and its cross-entropy on the labeled set. It works with any query strategy, has one hyperparameter, insensitive in practice, and adds only one batched forward pass over the unlab

translated_title: 基于几何一致性的无标签验证方法用于音频主动学习中的检查点选择
translated_abstract: 音频主动学习（AL）通过在连续多轮中仅对未标注数据集中最具信息量的部分进行标注，以较低的标注成本训练分类器。每一轮都需要从训练期间保存的检查点中选取一个。主流的AL协议依赖一个假设存在的验证集来完成这一选择，但在实践中，验证集的标签同样计入标注成本，从而削弱了本已有限的标注预算的优势。我们提出了几何一致性，这是一种用于检查点选择的无标签验证规则。该规则在冻结的预训练嵌入空间中，基于已标注集构建最近类均值和k近邻两种分类器，然后让它们对未标注数据进行预测以建模其几何结构。该规则根据每个检查点与这些伪标签的一致性以及其在已标注集上的交叉熵来对检查点进行评分。该方法可配合任何查询策略使用，仅有一个在实践中不敏感的超参数，并且只需对未标注数据进行一次批量前向传播即可。
tldr: 提出了一种基于几何一致性的无标签验证规则，通过在冻结预训练嵌入空间中利用伪标签一致性为检查点评分，使音频主动学习无需消耗标注预算构建验证集即可完成检查点选择。
en_tdlr: Proposes geometric consistency, a label-free validation rule that scores checkpoints via pseudo-label agreement in a frozen pretrained embedding space, enabling audio active learning to select checkpoints without spending annotation budget on a validation set.
